title: College Identity Card & Library Enrollment Circular
raw_notice_text:
GOVERNMENT POLYTECHNIC INSTITUTE
STUDENT WELFARE & LIBRARY DIVISION
CIRCULAR REF: GPI/ADM/2024/44
Date: 04 September 2024

ATTENTION: ALL FRESHLY ADMITTED DIPLOMA STUDENTS

All newly enrolled students across all branches are hereby directed to complete their Central Library digital access registration and obtain physical RFID identity cards.

ELIGIBILITY:
All candidates who have confirmed admission in the 2024-2025 academic session through the centralized counseling process.

PROCEDURE & DOCUMENTS REQUIRED:
Students must report to the Library Counter No. 3 with:
1. Copy of Provisional Admission Allotment Letter
2. Two recent stamp-sized color photographs
3. Blood group verification slip from any certified clinic

FEES:
Card processing charge of Rs. 150 must be deposited at the Accounts counter.

NOTE:
No submission deadline has been specified in this circular. Students are requested to contact the student affairs officer (Room 102) for the exact schedule and cutoff dates.
